When I read the title my immediate answer was "drink more!", but I have more details now.

Hmmm. You could always play frisbee! Or frisbee golf! Or some other amusing game involving throwing something around in a park or other scenic location. I hear drunken picnics can be a fun time, too. It's too cold for that shit on my side of the world, but it's quite enjoyable in warmer weather.

Failing that: drink more! I'm bad at advice.

Picnics at a park are usually cheap. Depending on where you live, you could go see some of the historic or cheap tourist attractions near you. You could also do a little volunteer work together at the animal shelter or something like that.

If you live in a major city, there are often tons of free or near-free things to do hiding all around the place, and some of them are much less boring than drunken you would assume. For example, a good art museum is surprisingly entertaining when you're with someone. Local zoos are often free as well. During the week, many bars have trivia nights, and there are likely to be card shops around too, that have weekly or monthly events like board game nights (trust me; it's just fine if you don't own anything better than Monopoly; many board game enthusiasts just want someone to play with). There's parks, what with their disc golf courses and hiking trails, more parks with their ponds and live fowl to watch/feed, yet more parks that make for great picnics and enjoying the fresh summer air...

If you live in a more rural area, the bar scene still pretty much holds true, and pretty much any place that isn't actually a building generally can be considered a park. Especially if you're drunk. Also, you obviously have at least limited internet, and that opens up a lot of things your gf and you can do together, that isn't just watching her be awful at video games (for example, making fun of fat people on Voat). The "weird part" of Youtube can also be a never-ending pool of entertainment with the right levels of sobriety.

Hope that helps!
